props: Use case: stylized-concept. Original richly detailed production pixel art for Chronforge Echo, native960x540 RPG. Hard crisp hand-placed pixel clusters and ink edges, overhead three-quarter prop perspective, cold upper-left light and restrained warm amber lamps. No blur, vector-flat shapes, characters, text or logos. Create FROST CANYON PROP ATLAS exactly4 columns by2 rows, eight equal square cells,2048x1024. True transparent alpha background, never painted checkerboard. Full isolated shapes with16px clear gutters, feet near bottom. Distinct glacial rescue frontier, not alpine forest: translucent blue ice, dark slate, rope, weathered ivory rescue machinery, warm amber lamps and small rust-red cloth. TOP ROW:1 immense sculptural blue ice formation like a twisted frozen willow, faceted branches and deep blue root-like ice fingers, no green foliage;2 slender rescue beacon mast of frost-caked ivory metal with a great warm amber lantern, rope ladders, torn rust-red rescue pennant and icy foot;3 monumental abandoned rescue engine, oval ivory-metal ring half-entombed in blue glacier ice, old amber lens in its heart and small stairs, solemn and practical;4 a dramatic natural ice arch supporting remnants of a rope-and-timber crossing, hanging icicles and weathered rescue cables. BOTTOM ROW:5 angular deep-blue ice boulders with cloudy white mineral cores and sharp frosted edges;6 warm rescue shelter with quilted rust-red canvas roof braced by ivory poles, a dark slate wall, deep amber-lit front entrance, coiled ropes, skis and stacked provisions, snowy footprint;7 delicate frost-blue arctic grass and small crystalline ice flowers growing from dark slate;8 towering stratified glacial cliff terrace with vertical turquoise-blue ice, pale snow lip and a snapped old rescue winch. Rich believable pixel materials, distinct silhouettes, no ground rectangles, no exaggerated bloom.

Native128px pixel materials enlarged4x. Quiet walkable centers: broad low-contrast fields with fine sparse detail, not a noisy rock carpet. No perspective, borders, gutters or props. TOP ROW:1 muted pale blue solid glacier ice with occasional very thin deep-blue cracks and cloudy white inclusions,2 very quiet smooth ivory-blue wind-packed snow with subtle shallow wind bands, almost no grain,3 walkable weathered slate rescue-path slabs with frost-filled seams, subdued steel anchors and no large repeated emblem. BOTTOM ROW:4 dark blue dense ice crust with a few thin silver cracks and sparse slate chips,5 shallow glacial meltwater with small translucent broken ice plates,6 deep cobalt crevasse water with very restrained blue reflections. Limited cold palette, crisp pixel clusters, no bloom, no sparkly high contrast noise.
